ordinary_text: same C12 64 exposed-DEV windows with RNG120099, 8192 targets; normal/zero-phase/shuffled-phase reads; no checkpoint selection

structured_retrieval.source: generated evaluation fixtures, not FIT and not a qualified real-world task
structured_retrieval.decisions: nine-way closed-set argmax; no threshold tuning; retain full-vocabulary top1 and target log probability too
structured_retrieval.safety: query answer omitted from inputs; prefill branch immutable; no parser/role labels control writes; labels used only to score
structured_retrieval.limits: same histories reused across seeds/delays/arms. Zero-shot unfamiliar grammar may produce floor performance. No training task-utility or production rejection guarantee.

replay: new fits exact fresh-process same-runtime replay; reused controls from a different runtime may use declared 2e-5 tolerance with maximum error retained
selection: fixed final update1024 for every new run; all seeds retained regardless of outcomes
success_interpretation: bank balance alone is not success. Report language loss, retrieval/overwrite/absent/map metrics, carry dependence and all seed differences. No architecture-superiority gate without full FLOPs and qualification.
